title: Bound jitter on a reactive retry without changing attempt counts
summary: Reactive retry now tolerates jitter larger than its five-millisecond delay and recovers on subscription two. A 107000-day jitter still overflowed during adaptation before the target publisher had any subscription.

change.description: The AOP interceptor derives Reactor’s jitter factor from nanoseconds, substitutes zero for zero delay, and caps the ratio at one.

notes: The large and small jitter inputs were both exercised with an immediately successful cold target. No long backoff was needed.

On Spring 7.1.0 this public interceptor is in org.springframework.resilience.retry. Recompiling the fixture with just that import changed reproduced all three results, including the synchronous overflow.
